value.hook: read when someone reports a just-compacted seat as over the limit
value.title: After a compaction, the digest's context figure is stale; read the footer

sections.name: body
sections.value: Seen three times (squirrel 09 Nov 19:42; spoonbill and ocelot 10 Nov 11:50): pm-001 or the prime asked me to compact a seat I had just compacted, quoting the old size (600k, 616k, 604k). The context figure they read is the last one reported before the compaction and doesn't update until the seat's next model call; the pane footer (NNNk/922k or NNNk/1.0M) and session.compaction_complete in the seat's events.jsonl are current. Before acting on a reported size, read the footer and the last compaction time, then answer with both.
